en: The image shows a vintage postcard featuring a large, ornate, three-story neoclassical building with a mansard roof. The building is labeled with the inscription 'KR. VELIKA GIMNAZIJA' above the entrance, and the top left corner of the postcard reads 'BJELOVAR, Gimnazija.' There are some trees and a fence in front of the building, and the style of the postcard suggests an early 20th-century print.
